posts.text:
Chuck Schumer is finished.

He can never again win a Democrat primary in New York. He knows it. 

Which is why I joke that he will be the inaugural member of the AOC for President Campaign.
posts.summary: Predicts Schumer's political collapse, endorses replacement by progressive challenger

posts.text:
My prediction: AOC will run for president, and Zohran Mamdani will replace Chuck Schumer in the Senate.

Some Republicans are cheering that our opponents are crazy. I’m not.

This is bad for America. I may disagree with Democrats on taxes and regulations, but this country needs two parties that actually love America.
posts.summary: Warns Democratic Party radicalization threatens two-party system, expresses concern for America
